about: Owner decision list D4 of the audit-fix spec (T3 item 2): every result that leaves `generatable` against dbc5eeb or 7345490f needs an owner decision. Proposals from benchmarks/t3/evidence.md; owner_decision stays null until the owner decides, and the executor never fills it. benchmarks/t3/tools/acceptance_compare.py separates a described transition (an entry matches) from an approved one (decision_format below) and lists every pending row with its exact key in the `d4_pending_rows` of its JSON report.

decision_format.owner_decision: null (pending) or {"decision": "accept" | "reject", "candidate_library_sha256": <64 hex of the accepted candidate>, "rows": [{"corpus", "file", "tokenizer", "outcome"}], "by": <name>, "date": <YYYY-MM-DD>, "note": <text>}
decision_format.approval: a transition row is approved only when its entry has decision accept, the decision names the candidate's library sha256 (the same hash in both corpora), and `rows` lists the row with the exact corpus, file, tokenizer and candidate outcome; a wildcard is never a row. An entry with requires_triage_class needs, in addition, that row's class in the T2c triage of the same candidate (benchmarks/triage_semantic.py --out-json) with every invalid document present and checked.
decision_format.candidate: candidate_library_sha256 above names the candidate the proposals were written for; a comparison with another candidate reports every decision as not applicable

entries.summary: engine_defect / BLG_ERR_DEAD_END in 17 of 20 passes (7345490f: 1 completed_valid, 19 step limits; dbc5eeb: 1 completed_valid, 18 step limits, 1 engine_defect)
entries.cause: engine defect, class A: the open-object certificate took the finite patternProperties language ^line[1-3]$ for an infinite one, so a key already seen was admitted again and dispatch refused it at the closing quote
entries.proposal: no owner decision: an engine defect, not a residual; D4 does not close no_defects. Fixed on the release line (open-object certificate patch, R7); the acceptance of the next candidate must show the schema without DEAD_END, and a remaining transition reopens R7

entries.summary: RESOURCE_LIMIT in 1 of 20 passes (pass 8, step 6225, 2.5 s); on dbc5eeb and 7345490f the same pass ends in the 10 s time limit near step 1600 and reaches the same state at step 6225 after 40 s with a 120 s budget
